description: §42.2.3 — a standalone `given` guard whose body is not a `{ … }` block (`given id :> fail LoadError.NotFound; return "ok"`) SHALL be refused with E-SYNTAX-044 (exactly once, no W-GIVEN-PRESENCE-DEPRECATED). Before S462 impl#1 emitted an empty `if` and then ran the `fail` unconditionally. A `given x :> expr` match arm is a different production and is not refused (condition/given-presence-deprecated-arm).
rationale: §42.2.3: `given-guard ::= 'given' identifier-list (':>' | '=>') block` — a guard body is a block; E-SYNTAX-044 is the malformed-guard refusal. Provenance: PA ruling (S462 fix round 1, pa-ruled under the governing grammar; corpus measured 0), ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a".
